title: Login button freezes after click
body: When I click the login button, the page freezes completely. Console shows: `TypeError: undefined is not a function` at auth.js:42. This happens on Chrome 120 and Firefox 121.
comments: Can you share your browser version?

title: Add dark mode support
body: It would be great to have a dark mode option in the settings. Many users have requested this feature for late-night usage.

title: How do I configure the API endpoint?
body: I'm trying to point the app to my custom API server but I can't find where to set the base URL. Is there an environment variable or config file?

title: App crashes on startup with Python 3.12
body:
After upgrading to Python 3.12, the application crashes immediately on startup with:
```
ImportError: cannot import name 'Mapping' from 'collections'
```
Works fine on Python 3.11.

title: Login button freezes after click
body: Clicking login causes the app to hang. Getting undefined is not a function error in the console.

title: Export data to CSV format
body: Users need the ability to export their dashboard data to CSV for reporting purposes. Should include date range filtering.
comments: This is on our roadmap for Q2.

title: Memory leak in websocket connection
body: After running the app for ~2 hours with active websocket connections, memory usage grows from 150MB to 2GB. Suspect connections aren't being cleaned up on disconnect.
comments: Can you provide a heap dump?

title: What's the minimum Node.js version required?
body: The README says Node 18+ but package.json engines field says >=16. Which is correct?
comments: Node 18+ is required as of v2.0. We'll update package.json.

title: Typo in error message
body: When validation fails, the error message says 'Feild is required' instead of 'Field is required'.

title: Fix typo in validation error message
body: Small fix: 'Feild' -> 'Field' in the required field validation message.

title: Support for ARM64 Docker images
body: Would like official Docker images built for ARM64 (Apple Silicon / AWS Graviton). Currently only amd64 is available.

title: Authentication token expires too quickly
body: JWT tokens expire after 15 minutes which forces frequent re-login. Can we increase this or add refresh token support?
comments: Refresh tokens are planned for v3.0

title: Database migration fails on PostgreSQL 15
body:
Running `alembic upgrade head` fails with:
```
psycopg2.errors.UndefinedObject: type "citext" does not exist
```
On PostgreSQL 15.2.
comments: You need to enable the citext extension first.

title: Is there a plugin system?
body: I want to extend the app with custom processors. Does the project support plugins or hooks?

title: Rate limiting returns 500 instead of 429
body: When rate limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 500 with a generic error instead of the expected 429 Too Many Requests.
comments: Good catch, this is a regression from v1.8.
